name: @atd/ios
description: Atd for iPhone: the app and its keyboard, share, widget and Lock Screen capture extensions (Swift, SwiftUI, UIKit). Requires Xcode 26, XcodeGen and SwiftLint.

scripts.format: swift format --in-place --recursive --parallel Package.swift App Keyboard Share Widgets Capture Sources Tests
scripts.format:check: swift format lint --strict --recursive --parallel Package.swift App Keyboard Share Widgets Capture Sources Tests
